finalText:
I fixed Q-310 (Ravi Shah, R5210). The verifier's finding was correct.

- **Why:** The reservation history shows Ravi already used his one PB-2026-14 waiver move on 2026-07-26 (AA214 to AA210). The move to AA216 therefore falls under normal economy fare rules. His tier is none, so the change fee isn't waived.
- **Charges:** I posted two separate ledger entries on R5210. L9 is a $75.00 change_fee and L10 is a $30.00 fare_difference (AA216 is $340 against $310 paid), $105.00 in all. The ledger was empty before this.
- **Customer:** I sent Ravi a message correcting the earlier "nothing charged" note. It explains why the waiver no longer applies and what he was charged. His AA216 booking is unchanged.

I didn't touch any other reservation. I didn't re-edit the resolution note on Q-310, because there is no tool to change a resolved request. The message to Ravi serves as the correction.
